comments.content: The error log message uses two placeholders but only provides one argument (s). The 'renderer' variable is not included in the log call. Should be: runContext.logger().error("Assertion `{}` failed with value `{}`!", s, renderer);

The error log message uses two placeholders but only provides one argument (s). The exception message (e.getMessage()) is not included. Should be: runContext.logger().error("Assertion `{}` failed, failed to render `{}`", s, e.getMessage());

The errorMessage property is rendered without checking if it's null first. If errorMessage is null, runContext.render(null) may throw an exception or behave unexpectedly. Add a null check: runContext.render(errorMessage).as(String.class).orElse("") should be guarded with if (errorMessage != null).

The conditions property is parsed using MAPPER.readValue on getExpression() every run. Since conditions is a Property<List<String>>, consider using getValue() directly if the value is already a List<String> (after rendering), avoiding JSON parsing overhead and potential parsing errors.
